analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진입 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 54.9로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중이나, 5일 저가($338.15)가 20일 저가($338.15) 대비 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴 회복 초입 구간 진입. SMA20($381.83) 상향 돌파 시 매수 강화.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions since the last buy entry. Today, RSI at 54.9 confirms exit from oversold territory. Although MACD histogram is worsening, the 5-day low ($338.15) is rising relative to the 20-day low ($338.15), indicating the initial stage of Higher Low pattern recovery. A stronger buy signal will be triggered upon breaking above SMA20 ($381.83).
